subject.title: feat(gateway): pre-handshake WS verifyClient with Sec-Fetch-Site and forwarded-header hardening

question: Should OpenClaw expose these three pre-handshake WebSocket and proxy-hardening controls as a separate `gateway.security.*` operator policy, or should their direction and naming be consolidated with the ongoing Gateway origin-policy work?
rationale: The branch is technically bounded and default-off, but choosing permanent Gateway configuration vocabulary and the boundary between origin policy and header/proxy policy is a maintainer product and security-contract decision.

options.title: Approve the bounded opt-in policy
options.body: Keep the three default-off `gateway.security.*` settings, contingent on current-head raw-wire proof for duplicate-header rejection and clear public operator guidance.

options.title: Consolidate policy direction first
options.body: Pause this PR until the owner aligns its settings and documentation with the remaining origin-policy direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98924.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded opt-in policy
recommendation.body: Keep the three default-off `gateway.security.*` settings, contingent on current-head raw-wire proof for duplicate-header rejection and clear public operator guidance.
